text: Bob Gore, Robert Gore & Associates Chartered Professional Accountants, reporting on the Auditor General's Office for the City of Toronto - Report on the Results of Applying Specified Auditing Procedures to Financial Information Other Than Financial Statements for the Year Ended December 31, 2019.
